{{Quote|Mak Luunim lives on the twenty-third floor.|Leia Organa|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Mak Luunim's apartment''' was the home of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Mak Luunim]] located on the twenty-third floor of a grand white building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. It was filled with many works of art that depicted Luunim's image.<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after Luunim's [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] along with fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited his apartment during a [[Mission to Muunilinst|mission]] for the Rebel Alliance. Luunim's [[Mak Luunim's employee|employee]] led them inside the apartment where they were ambushed by six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the employ of [[Nal Kenuun]], a Muun [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who had Luunim killed. A short skirmish ensued and the Rebels managed to escape, leaving the apartment severely damaged.<ref name="Target" />
